references.text: The book of Psalms 15:26 speaks about evil coming from the heart, which is similar to what Jesus says in Mark 7:21 about evil thoughts that come from within.
In Isaiah 59:7, it is spoken of evil and injustice arising from human actions, which corresponds with Mark 7:21 regarding evil deeds that spring from the heart.
Hebrews 3:12 warns against an evil, unbelieving heart, which can be seen in connection with Mark 7:21 about how evil thoughts come from the heart.
The letter of James 4:1-3 discusses desires and conflicts that arise from within, reflecting the theme in Mark 7:21 about inner evil.
